{{Quote|This is a place for me to establish a new base&mdash;no matter how long it takes.|Naga Sadow|<ref name="FOTSE5" />}}
The '''Massassi Site''', also known as the '''Massassi ruins''', was a region of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], a jungle [[Moon/Legends|moon]] orbiting the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. The site comprised a group of [[Stone/Legends|stone]] temples that were built around [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] by order of the [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]], and it was named after the [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] warriors who once inhabited it and erected its monuments.

Although the Massassi temples were scattered across the surface of the jungle moon, some of the oldest and most importants temples belonged to the Site. Those would be known millennia later as the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], the [[Palace of the Woolamander]] and the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]]. In the wake of a [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Great Sith War)|devastating battle]] between the forces of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the ravaged complex was abandoned for several millennia. The [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] were amongst the rare visitors of the Massassi complex, on which they [[Duel on Yavin 4|dueled]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].

The Massassi Site was reoccupied in the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] established one of their central bases of operation in the Great Temple. The area was abandoned once again following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but this cluster of ancient ruins housed the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. [[11 ABY/Legends|Six years later]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] decided to use the Great Temple as the site of his [[Jedi Praxeum]]. The Massassi Site remained in use until [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]], with the [[Invasion of Yavin 4|destruction]] of Skywalker's academy by the extra-[[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] who called themselves the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

==History==
===A Sith Lord in exile===
{{Quote|A secret place&hellip; for a new start.|Naga Sadow on Yavin 4|<ref name="FOTSE5" />}}
[[File:Yavin_Massassi_archeological_site_location.png|thumb|left|250px|Location of the Massassi Site]]
In [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> at the end of the devastating conflict known as the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]], a [[Second battle of Korriban|space battle]] occurred between the forces of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] and [[Koros fleet|the fleet]] of [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], leader of the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]]. Sadow's forces, who had just [[First battle of Korriban|fought and won]] another battle with his rival [[Ludo Kressh]], were too diminished to sustain the assault. However, the Dark Lord himself managed to [[Battle at the Denarii Nova|fake his death]]. Aboard his [[Derriphan-class battleship|''Derriphan''-class battleship]], the [[Corsair (Derriphan-class)|''Corsair'']], Sadow fled to the uncharted regions and limped to the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]],<ref name="FOTSE5" /> located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> On this hospitable moon, he wished to rebuild the Sith Empire with the help of a few Massassi, the warriors of the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="FOTSE5" />

Sadow ordered the Massassi to assemble monuments, so his crew burned a piece of [[Tree/Legends|forest]] with their battleship's [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]], and then expanded outward from the burned clearing. An army of Massassi workers used their machetes to cut the lianas interconnected with felling trees, then mowed down the said trees with cables. When the surface of the site had been scoured clear of the jungle [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]], the Massassi began drawing up the plans of their future temples, and then the construction started.<ref name="FOTSE5" /> The primary material of their constructions was a sedimentary calcite compound with certain conductive alchemical impurities. Such compounds were similar to those that could be found on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] and [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], the homeworlds of the Sith species.<ref name="SWI92">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref>

The Sith survivors named this newly domesticated region "Massassi Site" after themselves,<ref name="GG2">[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin'', Second Edition]]</ref> and they established their [[Fortress/Legends|stronghold]] in the [[Temple of Fire]].<ref name="darklords4">[[Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith 4|''Tales of the Jedi – Dark Lords of the Sith'' 4]]</ref> While building the temples for their wordly master, the Massassi came to worship the red orb of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]] as a [[Deity/Legends|deity]], the god [[Yavin (deity)|Yavin]] who filled the skies of the fourth moon. The warriors developed an inferiority complex, and they found a new purpose in the building of temples: reach the sky and achieve godly status themselves.<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> Even after Sadow's death, the mutated descendents of his Massassi continued to inhabit the Site.<ref name="darklords4" />

===Den of Exar Kun===
[[File:Exar_Kun_Architect.jpg|thumb|right|Exar Kun had the Massassi expand the Site.]]
{{Quote|Welcome to the Yavin moon, Exar Kun. Great power is locked in these temples.|The spirit of Freedon Nadd|<ref name="darklords4" />}}
In [[3997 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> a [[Human/Legends|Human]] Jedi Knight named [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]] was seduced by the dark side of the Force. Kun discovered the spirit of [[Freedon Nadd]], who led him back to Sadow's tomb on Yavin 4. Perfecting his dark powers, Exar Kun appointed himself the new Dark Lord of the Sith. While amassing [[Brotherhood of the Sith|his own army]] of Dark Jedi, he subdued the local Massassi, forcing them to build new temples in his honor.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Among the temples that the Massassi built for Kun was the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]].<ref name="TSW6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> Kun put a roof comb on top of the Great Temple, which was intended to house arcane rituals.<ref name="IWT">''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]''</ref> When the alliance of the Jedi and the Republic threatened his newfound glory, Kun used the Massassi's souls to power his own greed, destroying them in the process. At the same moment, the Jedi army orbiting the moon created a devastating [[wall of light]], a powerful salvo of light side energy, which they launched at Yavin 4. This attack set the moon's jungles on fire, burning the rain forest of the Massassi Site to the ground.<ref name="BTM" /> Much of the buildings that stood on the moon were also destroyed in the process.<ref name="JASB">''[[The Jedi Academy Sourcebook]]''</ref> Since most of the Sith warriors were dead,<ref name="BTM" /> and others had fled the moon using emergency spacecrafts,<ref name="TNB">"[[The Night Beast]]"</ref> the temples of the Massassi Site were abandoned for millennia.<ref name="BTM" /> The Jedi Order ensured that the ecosystem of Yavin 4 would be restored by constructing a subterreanean [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] station,<ref name="KORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> which was known as the [[Lost City of the Jedi]] after it was abandoned.<ref name="LCOJ">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>

===Showdown on the Massassi Site===
{{Quote|I'm going to make you pay for what you've done.''"<br />"''Come, Padawan. Your fall will be my ascension to the Sith.|Anakin Skywalker and Asajj Ventress|audio=ImGoingToMakeYouPay.flac|<ref name="Clone Wars Chapter 17">{{CW|17}}</ref>}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when a pan-galactic conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] had been raging for four [[Standard month/Legends|months]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Jedi [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] was led to Yavin 4 in pursuit of a mysterious female [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] named [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. After engaging combat in the jungle,<ref name="CW18">{{CW|18}}</ref> the two ended up [[Duel on Yavin 4|fighting]] in the Massassi complex. The duel ended on a temple's roof when Skywalker gave up to his rage. He caused the stone Ventress was standing on to crumble, causing her to fall off of the edge of the building. [[Force scream/Legends|Roaring]] in rage, the Jedi left her for dead.<ref name="CW19">{{CW|19}}</ref> However, Ventress had in fact survived the fall, and she returned to her allies to keep fighting in the war.<ref name="Dreadnaughts of Rendili">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Dreadnaughts of Rendili]]''</ref>

===Rebel Alliance's headquarters===
{{Quote|You would prefer another target, a military target? Then name the system! I grow tired of asking this so it will be the last time: ''Where'' is the rebel base?|[[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] to [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="ANH" />}}
[[File:Yavinsentry.jpg|thumb|left|300px|The Alliance to Restore the Republic established their headquarters on the Massassi Site.]]
Thousands of years later, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] was founded in reaction to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a despotic regime led by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]<ref name="AGTSWU2">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> In the early [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the resistance, Alliance members scouted Yavin 4 and decided to establish their primary base on the Massassi Site. The [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] naturalist [[Dr'uun Unnh/Legends|Dr'uun Unnh]] gave their modern names to the temples in the site. These included the [[Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster/Legends|Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster]], the [[Palace of the Woolamander]], and the Great Temple itself.<ref name="db">{{DB|location|massassitemple|Massassi Temple}}</ref> The Alliance chose to specifically settle in the ruins of the Great Temple, as it was the largest structure in the area.<ref name="BTM" /> In order to meet their new base's energy needs, the Rebels also built a [[Power generator/Legends|power-generating station]].<ref name="GG2" /> The Rebels also maintained a few smaller command posts in various ruined structures of the surrounding area.<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the Alliance launched their desperate assault against the Empire's "[[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]," a moon-sized [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] that had enough firepower to destroy planets. The resulting combat, which came to be known as the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], ended with the destruction of the Death Star and a decisive victory for the Alliance.<ref name="ANH" /> Following that crushing defeat, the Empire launched a series of attacks in retaliation, and the rebels were forced to [[Evacuation of Yavin|leave]] Yavin 4<ref name="MDM">"[[Doom Mission]]"</ref> six months after the Death Star's demise.<ref name="NEC" />

===Restful gardens of the new Jedi===
{{Quote|The Massassi are gone, their works crumbling, battered by war, violated by trespassers. But Yavin still rules over their world.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="BTS" />}}
[[File:Kyp_and_Dorsk82-Leviathan.png|thumb|right|Jedi apprentices [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Dorsk 82]] on the Massassi Site]]
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the Galactic Empire was defeated at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], and the Alliance evolved into the democratic government named the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NEC" /> One year later, the Republic established the headquarters of the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] in the refitted Palace of the Woolamander.<ref name="GoDV">''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]''</ref> However, when the new government [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|recaptured]] the world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the Senate was relocated on this planet, which had been the galactic seat of power for millennia.<ref name="X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

The Massassi Site then remained unoccupied until [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], when [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] decided to establish his [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi academy]] on Yavin 4.<ref name="NEC" /> The new government decided to establish a [[New Jedi Order]] to further protect its institutions, and the history-loaded Massassi Site appeared as the ideal location to train fresh [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi recruits]] in relative safety and autarcy.<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

Aside from rearranging the temples, the Jedi also installed their training grounds on the Massassi Site, notably in a set of ruins located to the South of the Great Temple.<ref name="JK:JA">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref> The old Rebel power generator had been repaired by Skywalker and his droid [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] during their preparation for the Jedi academy. While the Rebel Alliance had been far too busy in its war against the Empire to bother with archaeological inspections,<ref name="JS" /> Master Skywalker and his students took the time to survey the Massassi Site in detail, discovering other temples&mdash;including the [[Temple Atun]]&mdash;and retrieving ancient artifacts like the [[Books of Massassi]].<ref name="BTS" />

In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] used the [[Scepter of Ragnos]] to drain [[Unidentified Massassi temple|one of the Massassi temples]] of its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] energy.<ref name="JK:JA" />

In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], a species of [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] aliens known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invaded the galaxy, starting [[Yuuzhan Vong War|one]] of the most devastating conflicts ever fought in history.<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Thanks to an illusory projection generated by the Force, the New Jedi Order's were preserved for a time, but the Yuuzhan Vong eventually [[Invasion of Yavin 4|assaulted]] Yavin 4 in [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] and drove the Jedi out.<ref name="NEC" /> Now the invaders had captured the planet, they used [[damutek]]s&mdash;giant, star-shaped organic buildings&mdash;to raze the buildings from the Massassi Site and began [[Terraforming/Legends|terraforming]] the moon's surface.<ref name="EoV:C" /> [[29 ABY/Legends|Four years]] later, the Yuuzhan Vong were defeated following the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar]], but Grand Master Luke Skywalker decided not to rebuild his academy on the Massassi Site, opting to establish a [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|new one]] on the planet [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] instead.<ref name="TUF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>

==Layout==
{{Quote|The shuttle flew on easily and just missed clipping some trees as we came down in the clearing on the east side of the Temple. There, at the base, I saw a long, low opening of sufficient height that I could have tucked the shuttle on inside, but a landing zone had been laid out well clear of that area.|[[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], landing on the Massassi Site for the first time|<ref name="I, Jedi">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Massassi_Site.png|thumb|left|Map of the Massassi Site]]
A vast area surrounded by forests, the Massassi Site comprised the Great Temple, a fortress of the Massasi people, and two other monuments located to the South-East zone, known to the modern archaeologists as the Temple of the Blueleaf Cluster and the Palace of the Woolamander.<ref name="GG2" /> In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], orbital surveys revealed that more structures still lay buried under the thick vegetation, but the Alliance had been far too wrapped up in its struggle against the Galactic Empire to conduct thorough archaeological expeditions. The Massassi site was crossed by a wide warm river of a sapphire-blue color overlaid with muddy swirls of brown.<ref name="DAN">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> This river divided the area into three parcels, each with its own temple.<ref name="GG2" />

When the Alliance to Restore the Republic took up its quarters on the site, the considerable clearing in front of the Great Temple was turned into a landing pad for incoming starships, and a power generator was built<ref name="GG2" /> two [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] away<ref name="IWT" /> from the west wall of the temple.<ref name="GG2" /> On the uppermost level of the temple, the Rebels constructed an observation deck that allowed them to see the entire Massassi Site from above the trees.<ref name="BTM" /> Other notable features of the Massassi Site were a circular water fountain and a viaduct ending in a reflecting pool. By the time of the Galactic Civil War, the pool was completely dry and invaded by vegetation, but the fountain was still functional.<ref name="BFII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Massassi Site first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the first installment of the [[original trilogy]], which was released in [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> The forests and the temples of the Massassi Site were filmed in the [[Wikipedia:Maya civilization|Maya civilization]] ruins of the [[Tikal]] National Park in [[Wikipedia:Guatemala|Guatemala]].<ref name="BTM" /> The same Tikal location was also used in the [[1978]] [[The Star Wars Holiday Special|''Star Wars Holiday Special'']] to portray the green canopy of the then unnamed [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]&mdash;[[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="Holiday Special">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref>

The shot in ''Star Wars Episode IV'' where a Rebel sentry oversees the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] landing on the Massassi Site was shot on top of [[Wikipedia:Tikal Temple IV|Tikal Temple IV]], looking east where the roof combs of [[Wikipedia:Tikal Temple I|Temple I]], [[Wikipedia:Tikal Temple II|II]] and [[Wikipedia:Tikal Temple III|III]] can be seen.<ref name="Outerspace">{{WebCite|url=http://travelbbad.com/outerspace-travel-on-earth-tikal|text=Outerspace travel on Earth: Tikal|work=Travels of a B.B.A.D Woman|archivedate=20130211025500}}</ref> Today, this same shot is often recreated by tourists and photographers who visit the Tikal site.<ref name="Outerspace" /><ref name="Journey">{{WebCite|url=http://trans-americas.com/blog/2011/11/tikal-archaeological-site-guatemala|text=If We Had to Pick a Favorite&mdash;Tikal National Park Archaeological Site, Guatemala|work=Trans-Americas Journey|archivedate=20160318103641}}</ref>

[[File:Massassi_Site_Williamson.png|thumb|right250px|Al Williamson's early vision of the Massassi Site]]
An early depiction of the Massassi Site was often featured throughout the 1980s series of comics ''[[Classic Star Wars]]'', which was written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and drawn by [[Al Williamson]].<ref name="CSW2">[[Classic Star Wars 2|''Classic Star Wars'' 2]]</ref> The temples shown in this series were shaped more like the rectangular summit shrines of Tikal temples rather than the whole structures.<ref name="TKP">{{WebCite|url=http://tikalpark.com/temple.htm|text=Temples of Tikal|work=Tikalpark.com|archivedate=20020712180144}}</ref> However, later depictions of the Massassi Site's temples in [[canon]] more closely resemble full [[Wikipedia:Step pyramid|step pyramids]].<ref name="GG2" />
